build_provenance.commit_source: git rev-parse HEAD, asked of the tree being packaged
build_provenance.editable_installs: not stamped: an editable install is the working tree rather than a distributable artifact, and `techtree release info` reports that no commit was stamped instead of naming one
build_provenance.in_the_committed_tree: never; the stamp belongs to one artifact and is written and removed by the build
build_provenance.mechanism: a hatchling build hook, tools/stamp_provenance.py, writes the source commit into the package while the wheel is being built
build_provenance.refuses: a build with no git, no commit, or any packaged path (src/techtree, pyproject.toml, README.md, LICENSE) differing from that commit; there is no unknown value and no default
